//: Copy this file to config.json and edit it. config.json is gitignored. You can also manage everything from the dashboard.
//retailer: Which retailer(s) to actively run: target | walmart | both. The other retailer's products stay listed but paused.

products.//: A product CARD: the bot buys any Target product whose title contains at least matchThreshold of these keywords.
products.name: Prismatic Evolutions ETB

products.//: A Walmart product: give it a walmart.com/ip/... URL (or itemId) and set retailer to walmart.
products.name: Pokemon Prismatic Evolutions ETB (Walmart)

monitor.//: Target's data API is blocked, so stock is always checked through the real browser. pollIntervalMs is how often each product's tab re-checks.
monitor.//walmart: Walmart PDP sweep cadence per product (ms). Walmart has no free stock API, so a dedicated tab reloads each Walmart page.

checkout.//: SAFETY: when autoPlaceOrder is false, the bot fills the cart and stops at the review screen so YOU click 'Place order'.
checkout.//dryRun: When true, runs the whole flow but never submits payment (for testing).
checkout.//targetSoldOnly: When true, skip third-party Target Plus marketplace items and only buy items sold by Target.
checkout.//dropMode: Pokémon drop tips: fast polls, Ship-it-first checkout, qty cap, retries, clear cart.
checkout.//walmartQueueMode: Walmart drops: join virtual queue first; hold tab without reload while in line.
checkout.//cvv: Not stored here. Enter CVV in the dashboard top bar. Optional Remember stores it in data/local-secrets.json only.

//checkoutProfile: Name/address/billing autofill for Target checkout. Saved via dashboard Profile section. Never put full card numbers here.
//accountMode: single = shared ./browser-data Chrome. multi = up to 5 isolated profiles (browser-data/<id>).
//proxyGroups: Named proxies. Credentials can also come from PROXY_<GROUP>_USER / PROXY_<GROUP>_PASS env vars.

aiAssistant.//: Watches running checkouts and auto-recovers stalls (dismiss popups, retry, reload). Heuristics are free; add an OpenAI key (or set OPENAI_API_KEY env) for smarter recovery on unusual pages.
